definition: A community represented by a Boolean accepts exactly its own same-labeled proposal. Both communities satisfy this membership rule on their own proposals, but they disagree about the fixed proposal true. This is a coherent practice-local convention, not a truth predicate, universal justification or a categorical duty. Its failure of identity-independent public comparison is a conditional mismatch with that declared policy, not a logical contradiction in local convention.
